summary: @ornikar/eslint-config-react preinstall downloads Bun and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: Package advertised as an ESLint config declares a preinstall script ("node setup.mjs") that fetches a platform-specific Bun runtime from oven-sh/bun GitHub releases, extracts the binary, chmods it executable, and uses it to run a bundled sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB obfuscated script exhibiting string-array-obfuscator output (shuffled constant array with a rotator function WV8StW that push/shifts entries) and the '// @bun @bun-cjs' header. setup.mjs itself is obfuscated (hex-name identifiers, string-map indirection). Installing the package causes an alternate runtime to be downloaded and used to execute opaque, obfuscated code on the installer's host — behavior unrelated to the package's stated purpose of providing an ESLint configuration.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
